title: Cedar Key (U-Bahn Nurikabe)
author: MaizeGator
rules:
🌴

This puzzle is named after Cedar Key, a small town on Florida’s Gulf Coast. It’s among the most fun places I’ve visited that few people seem to know about. You can rent a pontoon boat for the day and explore the surrounding islands. Just be sure not to stay on one island for too long, because you gotta see ’em all! Oh, and watch out for horseshoe crabs!

Rules

U-Bahn

Draw a loop network through the centers of some cells, which may branch or turn, but may not have any dead ends. A number outside the grid indicates how many times the corresponding line shape (i.e. a cross, branch, straight line, or turn) appears in the corresponding row or column, irrespective of the line shape’s rotation.

Nurikabe

Shade some cells such that all shaded cells are connected and no 2×2 area is fully shaded. Unshaded cells form orthogonally connected groups called “islands”. Each island contains at most one numerical clue, which gives the number of cells belonging to the island.

Interaction

The “shoreline” (perimeter) of each Nurikabe island is crossed exactly once by the U-Bahn network.

Solve in SudokuPad ↗
solutionCode: For each row except the last, the number of lines in the U-bahn network going down to the row below.
